q.line: It's more than real, a plastic universe
stanza: It's more than real, a plastic universe
And I wanna know your secrets, even when it hurts
You speak so soft, but there's something dark in there
And I think I'll ask for more than just a love affair
You're like sleep and the nights are adding up
Well, I wish I still smoked cigarettes and acted tough

q.line: We had finally found each other in the universe
stanza: I remember you a few days later in Tofino
Where we'd driven to play a show you'd set up for us at a surf shop to no one
Then we slept in the back of my truck and got woken up by the cops
And so went down to the fishing boat docks to ask whoever for a ride
Across the water to Meares Island to just get left there for the day
And we did, and brought some food to eat and went through the big trees
Abandoned and in love, totally insane, apart from the rest of the world
We had finally found each other in the universe

q.line: I'm back to save the universe
stanza: In an interstellar burst
I'm back to save the universe
Where slot machine confusion
And the plastic universe
Are objects of amusement
In the fiction of their curse
